story.title: The machines behind India's next AI wave
story.sourceContext: New multi-year order announced 23 November 2026; planned 10,000 GPU cluster first announced August 2026
story.claimStage: additional multi-year order announced; capacity planned, not independently confirmed fully installed

scenes.headline: AI needs more than code.
scenes.narration: AI doesn't run on code alone. Behind every powerful model is enormous computing infrastructure.

scenes.headline: A new AI compute order
scenes.subhead: L&T / Vyoma.AI / LTN Compute — newly announced order
scenes.narration: On November twenty-third, L and T announced another multi-year deal to deploy Nvidia B three hundred GPUs in Chennai.

scenes.headline: A large-scale commitment
scenes.note: The exact contract amount and added GPU count were not disclosed.
scenes.narration: The company classifies it as a large order: between twenty-five hundred and five thousand crore rupees.

scenes.headline: A larger AI factory vision
scenes.subhead: The broader project was announced in August 2026
scenes.note: Planned capacity; not a verified number of active chips.
scenes.narration: It expands a ten-thousand-GPU AI factory project that was already announced back in August.

scenes.headline: A plan isn't a live GPU count.
scenes.subhead: AI models need both advanced chips and infrastructure to train and run.
scenes.narration: These machines can support AI training and inference. But ten thousand is the planned cluster, not a confirmed count of running GPUs.

scenes.headline: Building the foundation of AI.
scenes.subhead: India's next technology chapter also needs physical computing power.
scenes.narration: The real milestone? India is building more of the physical infrastructure that advanced AI needs.

story.youtubeTitle: India's AI Boom Needs This Infrastructure | L&T's Chennai GPU Order
